statement.zh: 法尤姆北部新石器调查与发掘（含科姆 W、科姆 K 组合）见 Caton-Thompson & Gardner《沙漠法尤姆》（1934）。
statement.en: In the northern Fayum, Neolithic survey and excavations including Kom W and Kom K assemblages are documented in Caton-Thompson & Gardner The Desert Fayum (1934).
